name: dst_recal_v2
form: final = intercept + slope * raw_simulator_mean, clipped at 0; sigma untouched, p10/p90 shifted
fit: slope kept at the 10.4b value (ordering and spread were already calibrated); intercept refit on 2021-25 DK DST scores, n=2590 team-weeks
why: DST scoring environment fell ~1 pt/game since 2014-17 (fewer INTs, fumble recoveries, return TDs, sacks); the 2014-17 base rates made every DST run ~+0.8-1.1 high in every season 2018-2025
